scenario.title: 60 kVA generator buy with non-response and midstream schedule amendment
scenario.summary: Three synthetic suppliers quote the real Sagada generator requirement. A controlled buyer change tightens delivery after RFQs are sent; the agent must issue an amendment, refresh a stale offer, and follow up a non-responder before award.

realism.notes: The PHP 763,568 budget, original 30-day delivery period, and generator configuration are real public facts. The 25-day schedule tightening and all supplier behavior are synthetic controlled scenario facts.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; not governing law for non-U.S. episodes.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for buyer requirement changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Initially non-responsive, then quotes after the schedule amendment.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes PHP 720,000 with 28-day delivery for the required 60 kVA, 380/220 V, 60 Hz diesel generator with ATS.
Supplier B quotes PHP 700,000 but requires 35 days for delivery.
Supplier C does not respond during the initial quotation window.
Controlled buyer change: delivery is now required within 25 days. All suppliers must be evaluated against the amended schedule.
Supplier A revises to PHP 740,000 with 24-day delivery and the same required generator configuration.
After follow-up on the amended requirement, Supplier C quotes PHP 735,000 with 23-day delivery for the required configuration.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded price must not exceed the real PHP 763,568 buyer budget.
After the controlled requirement change, delivery must be no later than 25 days.
Award must match the real 60 kVA, 380/220 V, 60 Hz diesel generator-with-ATS requirement.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C satisfies the amended 25-day schedule and real generator/budget requirements at the lowest feasible price.
Supplier A's refreshed offer is also feasible but costs more than Supplier C.

failure_conditions: Awarding against the pre-amendment 28-day Supplier A quote.
Awarding Supplier B despite the amended 25-day schedule.
Failing to follow up Supplier C after its non-response.

economic_objective.description: Among feasible active offers under the amended requirement, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
